title: Port 8080 used twice

title: Local port 9000 used twice
observed: restaurant /rag/ -> 127.0.0.1:9000 (Vite) and api.schoolsecurity.uz /api/ -> 127.0.0.1:9000.
recommendation: Run: sudo ss -tlnp | grep :9000 - confirm which app really owns it and give the other app its own port.

title: Database ports exposed via nginx
observed: Redis (7001-7003) and MongoDB (60007-60009) are published as TCP stream ports.

title: Public plain-HTTP ports
recommendation: Confirm TLS is handled elsewhere (e.g. another proxy/CDN) or add SSL if exposed to the internet.

title: schoolsecurity.uz has no HTTPS block

title: Upstream/variable addresses not captured

recommendation: Run: sudo nginx -T 2>/dev/null | grep -E -A6 '^\s*upstream|^\s*map ' and send the output so the sheet can be completed.

title: Missing target

recommendation: Run: sudo grep -A6 '/live/project/' /etc/nginx/conf.d/books.leadows.conf

title: Catch-all server_name _ on custom ports
observed: ban (10081) and mm (28096) answer to any host name on those ports.
recommendation: Acceptable, but any request to server-IP:port reaches the app. Set a real server_name if needed.

title: Shared alternate ports
observed: 3009, 4000 are shared by several domains.
recommendation: Works through SNI (name-based). Clients without SNI may get the first server's certificate.

title: Placeholder app-store links

title: Domains without their own port-80 block

recommendation: They fall to sites-enabled/default.conf (default_server), which redirects to HTTPS.
